# TikTok LIVE Studio Local Data Access

> A local WebSocket protocol that allows approved third-party applications on the creator machine to receive TikTok LIVE Studio likes, gifts, and chat events.

Protocol version: `1.0.0`. The endpoint is loopback-only at `ws://127.0.0.1:30000-30015/v1/third-party`. A client must validate `SERVER_HELLO` before sending credentials. The public documentation is the source of truth.

## Start Here

- [Overview](https://tiktok-live-studio-local-data-access.pages.dev/guide/overview): Product scope, prerequisites, and local-only deployment model
- [Quick Start](https://tiktok-live-studio-local-data-access.pages.dev/guide/quick-start): Minimum discovery, authentication, and event-receive flow
- [Architecture](https://tiktok-live-studio-local-data-access.pages.dev/guide/architecture): Recommended client boundaries and lifecycle
- [Agent Skill](https://tiktok-live-studio-local-data-access.pages.dev/guide/agent-skill): Install and use the reusable cross-stack coding-agent workflow

## Protocol

- [Connection Lifecycle](https://tiktok-live-studio-local-data-access.pages.dev/protocol/connection): Endpoint discovery, hello validation, native heartbeat, and reconnection
- [Authentication](https://tiktok-live-studio-local-data-access.pages.dev/protocol/auth): `SERVER_HELLO`, `AUTH`, and `AUTH_RESULT` contracts
- [Event Envelope](https://tiktok-live-studio-local-data-access.pages.dev/protocol/events): Common event shape, public user object, optional fields, and deduplication
- [Errors and Disconnects](https://tiktok-live-studio-local-data-access.pages.dev/protocol/errors): Authentication errors, disconnect reasons, and client retry behavior

## Events

- [live.like](https://tiktok-live-studio-local-data-access.pages.dev/events/live-like): Like payload and string count fields
- [live.gift](https://tiktok-live-studio-local-data-access.pages.dev/events/live-gift): Gift payload, combo fields, and gift object
- [live.chat](https://tiktok-live-studio-local-data-access.pages.dev/events/live-chat): Plain-text chat payload
